[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Scrambled Eggs with Spinach and Feta: Scramble 2 eggs with 1/4 cup fresh spinach and 1 tablespoon feta cheese, served with whole-grain toast (10 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs: Toast whole-grain bread, mash 1/2 avocado, and top with 2 poached eggs (12 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Quick Oatmeal with Banana and Honey: Cook 1/2 cup rolled oats with 1/2 cup water or milk, topped with sliced banana and a drizzle of honey (5 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Overnight Oats: Mix 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup milk, and choice of nuts, seeds, or fruit in a jar, refrigerate overnight (prep time: 5 minutes, cook time: 0 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Greek Yogurt with Berries and Granola: Layer 6 oz Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup mixed berries, and 2 tablespoons granola in a bowl (5 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Yogurt Parfait with Banana and Honey: Layer 6 oz Greek yogurt, sliced banana, and a drizzle of honey in a bowl (5 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Berry Bliss Smoothie: Blend 1 cup frozen mixed berries, 1/2 banana, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, and 1/2 cup milk (5 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Mango Peach Delight Smoothie: Blend 1 cup frozen mango, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup milk, and 1 tablespoon honey (5 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Peanut Butter Banana Toast: Toast whole-grain bread, spread with 1 tablespoon peanut butter, and top with sliced banana (3 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Cottage Cheese and Fruit: Mix 1/2 cup cottage cheese with 1/2 cup fruit, such as berries or sliced peaches (5 minutes).
